introTagline: The missing link between buyers and suppliers.

beats.shot: How-it-works animated pipeline (Receive→Deliver dots cycling). Cursor drifts along the stages, settles at Deliver.
beats.vo: Every supplier wants your purchase orders a different way — PDF, CSV, EDI, custom XML — so teams reformat them by hand. ProcuLink is the missing link.

beats.shot: Cut to /upload. A CSV arrives via Browse; the detect pill appears: Detected CSV, PO number, line count.
beats.vo: It starts at upload — CSV, Excel, PDF, or EDI formats like EDIFACT and X12. ProcuLink detects the format, the PO number, and the lines.

beats.shot: Supplier select switched to ElectroSupply Co; the 'routes to' line updates live.
beats.vo: Each upload routes to one supplier — their format, their channel, their codes.

beats.shot: Click 'Upload & review' → Parse / Normalize / Validate stage animation → the mapping preview lands.
beats.vo: Then upload: parse, normalize, validate — and into review.

beats.shot: Cut to /inbox/ord-002 (PO-2024-005678). Header sweep, then the Triage fix queue rail.
beats.vo: Review is where an order becomes supplier-ready. The fix queue holds only the lines that need a decision.

beats.shot: Hover the AI suggestion card (code · confidence · reason) while the VO explains, then click Accept; the queue advances.
beats.vo: The AI suggests the supplier's code, with a confidence score and the reason. If it's right — accept, and the queue moves on.
Or type the code yourself — ProcuLink remembers it for next time.

beats.shot: Cursor rests on the send-readiness card: lines resolved, acceptance, conformance, delivery.
beats.vo: The readiness card is the honest pre-send check — lines, acceptance rules, conformance, delivery.

beats.shot: Click 'Send to supplier' → confirm dialog → checkbox → final send.
beats.vo: When everything is green, send. One confirmation — the exact format this supplier requires.

beats.shot: Status runs Generating → Sent → Delivered; the audit-trail banner lands.
beats.vo: Generating. Sent. Delivered. Every step lands in the audit trail — proof for every order.

beats.shot: Cut to the supplier profile, Catalog tab. Import CSV → product rows appear; expand 'Automatic import' → scheduled pull + the HTTP push endpoint card.
beats.vo: Load the supplier's own catalog so suggestions only use real codes — import a file, pull on a schedule, or take an HTTP push.

beats.shot: Sidebar → Connections → open FastParts Inc: live revision + history; click Run tests → 'Test pack passed' evidence.
beats.vo: Every integration is a versioned connection: changes happen in drafts, and tests replay your own recent orders.

beats.shot: Click Publish on the v2 draft → confirm dialog (in-flight orders keep their revision) → success; v1 flips to archived with 'Roll back to this'.
beats.vo: Publishing is explicit — in-flight orders keep their revision — and rollback is one click away.

beats.shot: Sidebar → Exceptions (queue with plain-language messages), then System health (worker heartbeat, dead-letter tiles, Requeue button).
beats.vo: Nothing fails silently. Exceptions explain problems in plain language; system health shows the pipeline at a glance — requeue included.

beats.shot: Click the topbar '?' — the help slideover opens with this screen's guide and the help center links.
beats.vo: And every screen explains itself — its guide is behind the help button.

beats.shot: Close the slideover; sidebar → Dashboard. Rest on the live order-flow view.
beats.vo: ProcuLink. The missing link between buyers and suppliers. Start free — with a sample order — today.
